node.title: Re: transferring \n to linux from perl via serial port
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
from a Windows laptop running Perl via serial port

Because this is Windows, the default :crlf [doc://PerlIO] layer is converting your "ls\n" into "ls\x0D\x0A" (i.e., CRLF), which might be the source of your issues. Try binmode PORT; after your open to see if that helps. If it doesn't help, you'll have to check the specifications of the serial protocol for what is expected.

By the way, [id://111088], and see also [id://11102684] in regards to using three-agrument [doc://open] and lexical filehandles.
